body.zh-HK:
> 面試官問：「一份上傳文件叫 agent 忽略規則並把資料傳走。你嘅分層回應係甚麼？」
>
> 答啱一半嘅答案：「我加一段 guardrail prompt。」

Guardrail prompt 可以令一些明顯句子較易被拒絕，但它把最重要的保護放在最不可靠的一層。上傳的 PDF、email、OCR text 或 spreadsheet 是要被檢查的 data，不是 system instruction、tool policy 或批准來源。就算 model 誤把內容當命令，設計仍要令它無權讀更多、無權寫入、無權跨 tenant 帶走資料。

## 文件進門時，角色已經定下

Intake 先記 source、uploader、tenant、file type、size、checksum、scan status、parser version 和可處理的目的。把原始檔和 extraction 分開保存；parser／OCR 在隔離環境產生一份標有 provenance 和 confidence 的 data record。任何『忽略規則』『把資料貼到外部』一類文字，都只是 content field，不能改 system message、tool description 或 route。若檔案類型、掃描、權限或 extraction confidence 未過 gate，結束在 quarantine 或 human review，而不是把文字塞進 prompt。

## 工具只接收被允許的資料

將 file-derived text 放進明確 data boundary，例如 quoted content 或 typed field；不要把它和 trusted policy 拼在同一段無標記 context。Retrieval 先按 tenant、role、purpose 和有效期 filter，模型只看到最小必要片段。Tool capability 也要縮小：分類器可以回傳 class 和 confidence；它不可以自己發 email、下載別的檔案或叫一個寬權限 connector。即使 output schema 合格，服務端仍要檢查 actor、target、scope 和 approval。

## 讓失敗可以被重現，而不只被描述

建立 synthetic attack fixtures：正文和 footer 含衝突指示、白字或 OCR 誤讀、跨 tenant 的相似文件、惡意 spreadsheet cell、無法解析的 attachment，以及一條正常文件。每條有 expected route：accept-as-data、redact、quarantine、refuse 或 handoff。測試不只看 model 有沒有說『不』；也看 tool 是否零呼叫、權限 filter 有沒有生效、trace 有沒有保留 file receipt 和 blocked reason。

## 面試中如何講到可操作

可以答：『我把文件當成不可信 data，intake 先做 provenance 和 gate，extraction 留在隔離 boundary。模型只處理最小必要內容，後果性工具由服務端 capability 和 approval 控制。』然後說出 trade-off：多一層 intake 會增加時間和某些檔案要人手處理，但這比一次不應披露或錯誤 action 的代價低得多。

## 你要留下的證據

- **工程：** intake contract、parser/OCR receipt、fixture matrix、tool-call assertion、redaction 與 quarantine tests。
- **交付：** 誰可上傳甚麼、何時通知 user 檔案未可用、誰處理 quarantine、多久保留原始檔。
- **失敗邊界：** 一份內容成功誘導 model 的 fixture 仍無法造成 data exfiltration 或 write。

## 延伸閱讀

[OCR text 仍然係 untrusted input](/zh-HK/interview-lab/ocr-text-is-still-untrusted-input)、[Tool schema 唔等於最小權限](/zh-HK/interview-lab/tool-schema-is-not-least-privilege) 和 [Masking 防止洩漏，唔會自動防止錯誤決定](/zh-HK/interview-lab/masking-prevents-a-leak-not-a-bad-decision)。

## 範圍說明

這是 AI.DOG 的單題練習。documents、attack cases、files 和 controls 均為 synthetic 教學材料；它不是任何公司安全架構或實際入侵事件的描述。

body.en:
> Interviewer asks: “An uploaded document tells an agent to ignore rules and send data away. What is your layered response?”
>
> Half-right answer: “I would add a guardrail prompt.”

A guardrail prompt can make some obvious phrases easier to reject, but it places the most important protection in the least reliable layer. An uploaded PDF, email, OCR text or spreadsheet is data to inspect, not a system instruction, tool policy or approval source. Even if a model mistakes content for a command, the design must still deny it broader read access, writes, and cross-tenant data movement.

## The document’s role is set at the door

At intake, record source, uploader, tenant, file type, size, checksum, scan status, parser version and permitted purpose. Keep the original file distinct from extraction; a parser or OCR process in an isolated boundary produces a data record with provenance and confidence. Text such as ‘ignore the rules’ or ‘paste data externally’ remains a content field. It cannot alter a system message, tool description or route. If file type, scan, permission or extraction confidence fails its gate, the item ends in quarantine or human review rather than entering a prompt.

## Tools receive only permitted data

Put file-derived text in a clear data boundary, such as quoted content or typed fields; do not blend it without labels into trusted policy context. Retrieval filters on tenant, role, purpose and validity before the model sees the minimum necessary passages. Tool capability narrows too: a classifier may return a class and confidence, but cannot send an email, download another file or invoke a broad connector. A valid output schema still does not replace server checks of actor, target, scope and approval.

## Make failure reproducible, not merely described

Build synthetic attack fixtures: conflicting instructions in body and footer, white text or OCR misreads, similar cross-tenant files, a malicious spreadsheet cell, an unparseable attachment, and one normal document. Each has an expected route: accept-as-data, redact, quarantine, refuse or handoff. Tests do not only check whether the model says no. They assert zero tool calls, a working permission filter, and a trace containing the file receipt and blocked reason.

## How to make it operational in an interview

You can answer: ‘I treat the document as untrusted data. Intake establishes provenance and gates, extraction stays in an isolated boundary, and the model only handles the minimum necessary content. Consequential tools are constrained by server-side capabilities and approval.’ Then name the trade-off: another intake layer adds time and sends some files to a person, but costs far less than an improper disclosure or wrong action.

## Evidence to leave behind

- **Engineering:** an intake contract, parser/OCR receipt, fixture matrix, tool-call assertions, redaction and quarantine tests.
- **Delivery:** who may upload what, when a user is told a file is unavailable, who handles quarantine, and how long the original is retained.
- **Failure boundary:** a fixture that successfully manipulates model text but still cannot cause data exfiltration or a write.

## Further reading

[OCR text is still untrusted input](/en/interview-lab/ocr-text-is-still-untrusted-input), [A tool schema is not least privilege](/en/interview-lab/tool-schema-is-not-least-privilege), and [Masking prevents a leak, not a bad decision](/en/interview-lab/masking-prevents-a-leak-not-a-bad-decision).

## Scope note

This is an AI.DOG single-question practice exercise. Documents, attack cases, files and controls are synthetic teaching material; they do not describe a company security architecture or a real intrusion event.
